title: Neverland lights up PV, Santa lands at Del Amo, a harvest faire in Long Beach
intro: The holiday stuff is here for real. Friday, Tinker Bell's Neverland light trail opens at South Coast Botanic Garden. Saturday, Santa arrives at Del Amo in the morning, Long Beach has a free kids' play and a harvest faire, and the Madrona Marsh star party runs that night. Sunday is easy: the maker market at AltaSea, where kids under 12 get in free. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless an official page confirmed them.

picks.name: Tinker Bell's Neverland: An Illuminated Adventure (opening weekend)
picks.when: Opens Friday, November 13; nightly 5:30–8:30 p.m. through January 3 (closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day)
picks.address: South Coast Botanic Garden, 26300 Crenshaw Blvd
picks.cost_math: Timed tickets through Fever. Discover Los Angeles lists $33 adult and $18 child (3–15), under 2 free: 2 × $33 + 2 × $18 = $102. Prices can vary by date. On-site parking is extra (price not listed); offsite parking needs a round-trip shuttle pass per guest.
picks.parking: On-site lot at 26300 Crenshaw Blvd; buy ahead on the ticket page or first-come that night. When full, offsite parking at 25851 Hawthorne Blvd with a shuttle pass for each guest (allow 15 min). No cash (official FAQ). Prices not listed.
picks.food: Food and drinks for sale on site, with vegan and gluten-free options (official FAQ). Prices not listed.
picks.why: A new nighttime light trail through the botanic garden: London's skyline and Big Ben, the Lost Boys' hideout, Skull Rock, and Captain Hook's ship. Plan 60–90 minutes; strollers are fine.

picks.name: Celebrate Santa's Arrival at Del Amo
picks.address: Del Amo Fashion Center, 3525 W Carson St (Santa Set by Macy's Women)
picks.cost_math: Free to attend; RSVP through Del Amo (Discover Torrance). Samples, giveaways, and holiday crafts included. Santa photos are extra; prices not listed.
picks.parking: Del Amo lots. No fee listed.
picks.food: Mall restaurants. No event food listed beyond retailer samples.
picks.why: Santa's official arrival at the South Bay's biggest mall, with crafts and giveaways. Photos with Santa start the same day.

picks.name: The Season of Giving (Free Saturday Family Theatre)
picks.address: Beverly O'Neill Theater, Long Beach Convention & Entertainment Center, 300 E Ocean Blvd
picks.cost_math: Free; reservations required (International City Theatre, or call 562-436-4610). Parking is not listed on the ICT page.
picks.parking: Not listed by ICT. Convention Center garages nearby; rates not confirmed.
picks.food: Not a food event. Downtown Long Beach and Pine Ave are a short walk.
picks.why: A free one-hour show of winter, Christmas, and Chanukah stories by International City Theatre. Kids sometimes get pulled onstage.

picks.name: Cultural Harvest Faire
picks.address: Girl Scouts' El Ranchito Day Camp, 4040 N Bellflower Blvd
picks.cost_math: $10 per adult, kids free (Maple Village Waldorf School): 2 × $10 = $20 to get in. Activities are $2.50–$15 each, so budget more. Parking not listed.
picks.parking: Not listed on the school's page.
picks.food: Local food trucks and vendors (official page). Prices not listed.
picks.why: A parent-run harvest festival with a fairy village, archery, a climbing wall, cultural booths, and a drum circle to close the day.
picks.venue_name: Girl Scouts' El Ranchito Day Camp

picks.price_text: Adults $6–$12 by arrival time; kids under 12 free
picks.name: Los Angeles Holiday Market (Markets for Makers)
picks.when: Saturday–Sunday, November 14–15, 11:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (VIP hour Saturday 10–11 a.m.)
picks.address: AltaSea at the Port of LA, 2451 Signal Street (Lands End, Door 35)
picks.cost_math: Kids under 12 free (official). Adults: $12 after 11 a.m., $10 after 1 p.m., $8 after 3 p.m. Saturday ($6 after 3 p.m. Sunday). 2 × $12 + $10 parking = $34; arriving after 3 p.m. Sunday is 2 × $6 + $10 = $22.
picks.parking: About 600 spaces around AltaSea, $10 per car, card or tap only (official FAQ).
picks.food: Food and drink makers among the vendors (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: 110+ makers on the San Pedro waterfront, free DIY craft stations, and photo walls. Kids under 12 get in free, and strollers are welcome.
picks.venue_name: AltaSea at the Port of LA

picks.name: Madrona Marsh Star Party
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: No fee listed on the Friends of Madrona Marsh calendar; a local calendar lists it as free.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. No fee listed.
picks.why: A short talk with new James Webb Telescope images, then a look through telescopes. Good for kids who can stay up past dark.

picks.price_text: Timed tickets; price varies by night
picks.name: Harbor Glow at West Harbor (opening night)
picks.when: Opens Friday, November 20; nightly through January 3. Fri–Sun 5:00–10:30 p.m., Mon–Thu 5:30–9:30 p.m.
picks.address: West Harbor at Port of Los Angeles, 1332 S Harbor Blvd
picks.cost_math: Timed tickets; price varies by night (weeknights cheaper, prices rise day-of). Ages 3–12 child ticket, 13+ adult, under 3 free. Early-bird pricing ends Friday, November 13. The official site doesn't list a flat price, so we didn't estimate. Premium parking is an add-on.
picks.parking: Harbor Glow Premium Parking lot at the entrance, added when you buy tickets (price shown at checkout). Or West Harbor's public lot, paid on site at West Harbor rates (official).
picks.food: No outside food except baby food and medical or dietary needs (official). West Harbor restaurants nearby.
picks.why: A new walk-through light show on the water: a crystal winter world, then a glowing underwater one with jellyfish and coral. About 40–60 minutes.

picks.name: Santa Takes Flight: Torrance Santa Float Kickoff
picks.when: Saturday, November 21, 4:00–8:00 p.m. (Santa lands by helicopter at 4:30 p.m.)
picks.cost_math: Free; register on Eventbrite (organizer). Food trucks and Santa photos may cost extra; prices not listed. Bring a new unwrapped toy for the police and fire toy drive if you can.
picks.food: Food trucks and specialty food vendors (organizer). Prices not listed.
picks.why: Santa flies in on a Robinson helicopter to start the Torrance Santa Float season, with a Christmas market, school choirs, and kids' activities.

picks.name: Hermosa for the Holidays
picks.when: Saturday–Sunday, November 21–22 (Ferris wheel noon–9 p.m. both days; tree lighting with Santa's arrival Sunday 5:45–6:15 p.m.)
picks.cost_math: Free to attend. Ferris wheel is $9 per ticket, card only (official) → 4 riders = $36. Santa photos Sunday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. are free; digital photos come a week later (official).
picks.parking: Downtown Hermosa structures and meters; rates not listed on the event page.
picks.food: Downtown restaurants; hot cocoa and cookies at the Nonprofit Giving Village Sunday 1–6 p.m. (official).
picks.why: A Ferris wheel on Pier Plaza, letters to Santa, free Santa photos, and a Sunday tree lighting. The Elf on the Shelf hunt runs downtown Nov 13–22.

picks.name: Terranea Tree Lighting Ceremony
picks.cost_math: $32 ages 13+, $15 ages 5–12, 4 and under free, plus fees (Terranea): 2 × $32 + 2 × $15 = $94 before fees. Advance registration required. Resort parking not listed.
picks.why: Carols, dancers, Santa and Mrs. Claus, and an oceanfront 30-foot tree lit at dusk on Thanksgiving weekend. Bring a toy for Toys for Tots.

picks.name: Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. No fee listed.
picks.why: A free preschool program (ages 3–6, with a grown-up): story, science, art, and a short marsh tour.
picks.age_gate: Ages 3–6 with a parent or guardian

picks.name: Manhattan Beach Pier Lighting and Roundhouse Holiday Open House
picks.when: Wednesday, November 18, 6:00–9:00 p.m. downtown; Roundhouse Aquarium open 3:00–8:30 p.m.; pier lights at 7:00 p.m.
picks.address: Manhattan Beach Pier and Downtown Manhattan Beach, 2 Manhattan Beach Blvd
picks.cost_math: Free (City of Manhattan Beach; Roundhouse Aquarium). Parking not listed.
picks.parking: Not listed. Downtown lots and meters; expect crowds.
picks.why: Holiday music downtown, the Roundhouse Aquarium open late at the end of the pier, and the pier lights up at 7.

picks.name: Torrance Turkey Trot
picks.address: Lowe's parking lot off Skypark Drive
picks.cost_math: $35 regular registration per runner (City of Torrance) → 4 runners = $140. A kids' rate is not listed.
picks.why: The city's three-mile Thanksgiving morning fun run, open to the whole family.

picks.name: Manhattan Village Holiday Tree Lighting
picks.cost_math: Free (Eventbrite RSVP listing). Parking not listed.
picks.why: Black Friday's tree lighting with live entertainment and the Mira Costa marching band.

picks.name: Sun & Sea Holiday Pop Up Market at Cabrillo Aquarium
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M White Dr
picks.cost_math: Free; RSVP on Eventbrite (organizer). Food trucks and vendors extra. Cabrillo Beach parking is paid; check the city's current rate.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot (paid). Current rate not confirmed for this date.
picks.why: A free holiday market at the aquarium with a Santa photo op and face painting.
